repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

body.description: Text describing the contents of the tag.

target_commitish.description: Specifies the commitish value that determines where the Git tag is created from. Default: the repository's default branch.

draft.description: true to create a draft (unpublished) release, false to create a published one. Default: false.

prerelease.description: true to identify the release as a prerelease. Default: false.
